trigger.event: New leads are created from various sources

actions: Auto-create two tasks for each new opportunity: send a sample pack and schedule a pricing call
Log email replies back to Salesforce
Automated approval step for quotes with discounts above 15%
responsible: Sales team for sending sample packs and scheduling calls

fields: Lead source (trade shows, website, social media, referrals, outbound calls)

conditions: If a quote has a discount above 15%, it requires approval

waits: Send sample pack within three days
Schedule pricing call within ten days

fallbacks: If the process fails to log email replies, notify the sales team
